###########################################################################
# Auto Medal (auto_medal_hoi4) - scripted effects  [GENERATED by tools/gen_script.py - do not edit]
# Player scope unless noted (ROOT = THIS = the player).
###########################################################################

# Every setting to its default value (the ranks of generals / marshals on the characters, the template name
# ranks and the medal order are kept).
amd_set_defaults = {
	set_variable = { amd_on = 0 }
	set_variable = { amd_dry = 0 }
	set_variable = { amd_pp_floor = 100 }
	set_variable = { amd_max_grants = 3 }
	set_variable = { amd_order = 1 }
	set_variable = { amd_short = 0 }
}

# Settings a save does not have yet (added by a later version) get their default;
# set_variable keeps a variable at 0, only clear_variable removes one.
amd_fill_missing = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = amd_on } } set_variable = { amd_on = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = amd_dry } } set_variable = { amd_dry = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = amd_pp_floor } } set_variable = { amd_pp_floor = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = amd_max_grants } } set_variable = { amd_max_grants = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = amd_order } } set_variable = { amd_order = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = amd_short } } set_variable = { amd_short = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = amd_tab } } set_variable = { amd_tab = 1 } }
	set_variable = { amd_version = 2 }
}

# First use on this country; afterwards only what a newer version added is filled in.
amd_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = amd_initialized } }
		amd_set_defaults = yes
		set_variable = { amd_tab = 1 }
		set_variable = { amd_version = 2 }
		set_country_flag = amd_initialized
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { amd_version = 2 } } }
		amd_fill_missing = yes
		set_variable = { amd_tab = 1 }   # the tabs were renumbered
	}
}

# Values the engine reads just before a run.
amd_write_inputs = {
	set_variable = { amd_in_humans = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		ROOT = { add_to_variable = { amd_in_humans = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = amd_gui_open }
		set_variable = { amd_in_open = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { amd_in_open = 0 }
	}
}

# Runs the engine. TICK = daily, APPLY = now, REFRESH = only re-read the medals / counts / template names (no grant),
# MOVE = move one medal in the order (amd_cmd_slot / amd_cmd_act), RESETMEDALS = default medal order,
# TPLSTEP = change the rank of the template name in row amd_cmd_slot (amd_cmd_act 1 = lower, 2 = raise).
# Single player only: with more than one human the engine is not called (the window says so).
amd_run_tick = {
	amd_init = yes
	amd_write_inputs = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { amd_in_humans < 2 } }
		set_variable = { amd_st_ok = 0 }
		log = "AMED:TICK"
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { amd_st_ok = 0 } }
			set_country_flag = amd_no_engine
		}
		else = {
			clr_country_flag = amd_no_engine
		}
		add_to_variable = { amd_list_rev = 1 }   # the medal rows redraw
	}
}

amd_run_apply = {
	amd_init = yes
	amd_write_inputs = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { amd_in_humans < 2 } }
		set_variable = { amd_st_ok = 0 }
		log = "AMED:APPLY"
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { amd_st_ok = 0 } }
			set_country_flag = amd_no_engine
		}
		else = {
			clr_country_flag = amd_no_engine
		}
		add_to_variable = { amd_list_rev = 1 }   # the medal rows redraw
	}
}

amd_run_refresh = {
	amd_init = yes
	amd_write_inputs = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { amd_in_humans < 2 } }
		set_variable = { amd_st_ok = 0 }

		else = {
			clr_country_flag = amd_no_engine

# Daily (on_daily, player only).
amd_daily_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = amd_initialized check_variable = { amd_on = 1 } }
		amd_run_tick = yes
	}
}

# Settings changed in the window (nothing to recompute: the engine reads them at its next run).
amd_settings_changed = {
	add_to_variable = { amd_list_rev = 1 }
}

# global event target amd_gen_<i> so the window can print its name and set `amd_rank` on it (its rank points:

# Row list of the field marshals tab: row i = the i-th army leader (is_field_marshal = yes); the character is saved as the
# global event target amd_fm_<i> so the window can print its name and set `amd_rank` on it (its rank points:
# 0 = 5th rank, 1..9 = 10 - rank, -99 banned; read by the engine). amd_<key>_pts_<i> mirrors it for the window.
amd_build_fm_list = {
	set_variable = { amd_fm_on_1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { amd_fm_on_2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { amd_fm_on_3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { amd_fm_on_4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { amd_fm_on_5 = 0 }
	set_variable = { amd_fm_on_6 = 0 }

	set_variable = { amd_fm_on_9 = 0 }
	set_variable = { amd_fm_on_10 = 0 }
	set_variable = { amd_fm_on_11 = 0 }
	set_variable = { amd_fm_on_12 = 0 }
	set_variable = { amd_fm_on_13 = 0 }

amd_open_window = {
	amd_init = yes
	set_country_flag = amd_gui_open
	amd_run_refresh = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_tab = 4 } } amd_build_gen_list = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_tab = 5 } } amd_build_fm_list = yes }
	add_to_variable = { amd_list_rev = 1 }
}

amd_close_window = {
	clr_country_flag = amd_gui_open
	add_to_variable = { amd_list_rev = 1 }
}
